t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2009, a temporary structure that has since been destroyed, so what you see today is not the building itself. It was designed by Kazuyo Sejima and Ryue Nishizawa, who together founded the Japanese firm SANAA in 1995. In 2010 the two shared the Pritzker Prize. Sejima was the second woman ever to win it, and Nishizawa the youngest person ever to receive it.
